content.short: Voltaire is an open-source ERC-4337 bundler written in Python by Candide wallet team.
content.description: Voltaire is a fast, open-source ERC-4337 bundler implemented in Python and maintained by the Candide wallet team. Candide is an open-source smart contract wallet that the team regards as an Ethereum public good. With Voltaire, the team aims to advance the adoption of contract accounts on Ethereum and other EVM networks through ERC-4337, helping developers and users participate in account abstraction more widely. This effort seeks to lower barriers to entry and accelerate experimentation with account abstraction across ecosystems.
